location_description: Panka Natural Health is a family-owned naturopathic and integrative medicine clinic in Hopkins, MN, established in 2018. Founded by naturopathic doctors Haley and Jacob Panka (Dr. Jacob also holds an MS in Integrative Medicine Research), we take longer, two-hour first visits and use advanced functional lab testing to find the root cause of your symptoms, not just a label for them. We care for hormones, cardiovascular and metabolic health, digestive concerns, brain and cognitive health, and whole families from infants to grandparents. Pay-per-visit, with no membership required. Serving Hopkins and the west metro, plus telehealth across Minnesota and Wisconsin.
